args.message: Upgrade fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

args.body:
Security fix: **CVE-2026-31337** — fastjson is affected by unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays (high severity).

- **Affected:** fastjson < 2.9.4
- **Fix version:** fastjson 2.9.4

This PR upgrades `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt — the minimal patch version that resolves the vulnerability. CI has passed on this branch.
args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
